info.name: RoadGuardSystem V2 API
info.description: RoadGuard V2 API smoke and manual test collection. Select the RoadGuard.local environment and set its local values before running.

request.description: Purpose: create a survey plan. Role: Project Manager with effective project scope. Setup: set projectId, roadSectionId and roadSectionVersionId from permitted fixtures; use a fresh Idempotency-Key. Expected: 201 plan and Location. Data change: plan, audit and idempotency receipt.

exec: pm.test('Survey plan create returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyPlanId', pm.response.json().planId);

request.description: Purpose: create a survey request from the plan. Role: Project Manager with effective project scope. Setup: run plan create first. Expected: 201 request. Data change: request, audit and idempotency receipt.

exec: pm.test('Survey request create returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyRequestId', pm.response.json().requestId);

request.description: Purpose: postpone an existing plan and append its reason. Role: Project Manager with effective project scope. Setup: run plan create first; use a fresh Idempotency-Key. Expected: 200 postponement. Data change: plan status/date, append-only postponement, audit and idempotency receipt.

exec: pm.test('Survey postpone returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Purpose: verify bearer authentication is required. Role: none. Setup: no token. Expected: 401. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Unauthorized survey plan returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Purpose: verify same idempotency key with changed payload is rejected. Role: Project Manager. Setup: run the success request first, then change the date while reusing surveyPlanCreateKey. Expected: 409 duplicate/idempotency conflict. Data change: none on conflict.

exec: pm.test('Changed idempotency payload returns 409', function () { pm.expect([409, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Purpose: list inspection tasks actively assigned to the current repair crew. Role: Repair Crew with effective project membership. Setup: login as the seeded crew account and set accessToken; optionally set inspectionCursor from a prior response. Expected: 200 InspectionTaskPage. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Inspection task list returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('items'); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('asOf'); if (b.nextCursor) pm.collectionVariables.set('inspectionCursor', b.nextCursor); }

request.description: Purpose: verify bearer authentication is required. Role: none. Setup: none. Expected: 401 ProblemDetails. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Unauthenticated inspection task list returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Purpose: verify role policy rejects a non-crew actor. Role: Project Manager/operator. Setup: set accessToken to a non-crew seeded token. Expected: 403 ProblemDetails. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Wrong role inspection task list returns 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

request.description: Purpose: verify cursor validation. Role: Repair Crew. Setup: login as seeded crew; no data mutation. Expected: 400 validation ProblemDetails. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Invalid cursor returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description: Purpose: confirm the API is reachable. Role: none. Setup: select RoadGuard.local and set baseUrl. Expected: 200 (or 204). Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Health is available', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 204]); });

request.description: Purpose: authenticate the selected seeded account. Role: any seeded role. Setup: set authEmail/authPassword in the environment. Expected: 200 with accessToken, refreshToken and user. Errors: 400/401 for invalid input. Data change: creates a session.

exec: pm.test('Login returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', b.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', b.refreshToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('profileRowVersion', b.user.version); pm.collectionVariables.set('targetUserId', b.user.id); }

request.description: Purpose: verify credential rejection. Role: none. Setup: API reachable. Expected: 401 and stable auth error without tokens. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Invalid login returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Purpose: obtain a separate operator token for survey-task assignment workflows. Role: Drone Operator. Setup: set operatorEmail/operatorPassword from the Development seed without committing the password. Expected: 200 with accessToken. Data change: creates a session.

exec: pm.test('Operator login returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('operatorAccessToken', pm.response.json().accessToken);

request.description: Purpose: rotate/refresh the active session. Role: authenticated session. Setup: run valid login first. Expected: 200 with replacement tokens. Errors: 401 for expired/revoked refresh token. Data change: session state may rotate.

exec: pm.test('Refresh returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', b.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', b.refreshToken); }

request.description: Purpose: request password recovery. Role: unauthenticated caller. Setup: set a permitted email. Expected: 202 without credential disclosure. Data change: creates a recovery request.

exec: pm.test('Recovery returns 202', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });
pm.test('Recovery returns Location', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.match(/^\/api\/v1\/auth\/password-recovery-requests\//); });
pm.test('No credential disclosure', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/passwordHash|temporaryPassword/i); });

request.description: Purpose: change the current user's password. Role: authenticated user. Setup: run login; set replacementPassword; use a disposable account and fresh Idempotency-Key. Expected: 204. Errors: 400/401/409 per contract. Data change: destructive credential/session change.

exec: pm.test('Password change returns 204', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });

request.description: Purpose: revoke the active session. Role: authenticated user. Setup: run login first; use a fresh Idempotency-Key. Expected: 204. Data change: session revocation.

exec: pm.test('Logout returns 204', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });

request.description: Purpose: create a pending Reporter registration and send OTP. Role: public. Setup: configure IdentityOnboarding secret/message provider and set reporterEmail/reporterPassword. Expected: 202 RegistrationIntent and Location. Data change: pending user, OTP hash and idempotency receipt.

exec: pm.test('Registration returns 202', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });
pm.test('Registration response is safe', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/password|otp/i); });
if (pm.response.code === 202) pm.collectionVariables.set('registrationIntentId', pm.response.json().intentId);

request.description: Purpose: reject non-Gmail Reporter registration. Role: public. Setup: none. Expected: 400 validation response and no durable user. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Invalid Reporter registration returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description: Purpose: consume the mailbox OTP once and issue Reporter tokens. Role: public intent holder. Setup: run registration, copy OTP from the configured mailbox into reporterOtp. Expected: 200 TokenPair. Data change: activates account and creates one session.

exec: pm.test('OTP verification returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', b.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', b.refreshToken); }

request.description: Purpose: reject an invalid OTP without issuing credentials. Role: public intent holder. Setup: use a pending registrationIntentId. Expected: 400/404/429 without tokens. Data change: failed-attempt counter only.

exec: pm.test('Invalid OTP is rejected', function () { pm.expect([400, 404, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('No token leak', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/accessToken|refreshToken/i); });

request.description: Purpose: resend OTP after cooldown. Role: public intent holder. Setup: pending registration; wait for resendAfterSeconds. Expected: 202, or 429 during cooldown. Data change: replaces OTP hash and advances generation once per key.

exec: pm.test('Resend respects cooldown', function () { pm.expect([202, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Purpose: Supervisor creates a one-time staff invitation. Role: Supervisor. Setup: login as seeded Supervisor, store its token in supervisorAccessToken, set invitationEmail. Expected: 201 with ETag and Location. Data change: invitation/token hash/idempotency receipt.

exec: pm.test('Invitation create returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Invitation token is not returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/invitationToken/i); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('invitationId', b.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('invitationVersion', b.version); }

request.description: Purpose: prove a non-Supervisor cannot invite. Role: authenticated non-Supervisor. Setup: set operatorAccessToken. Expected: 403 and no invitation. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Non-Supervisor invite returns 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

request.description: Purpose: accept a one-time invitation and support same-key replay. Role: public invitation holder. Setup: run create, copy token from mailbox into invitationToken, set invitationPassword. Expected: 200 TokenPair on first call and same-key replay. Data change: creates account/memberships/session once.

exec: pm.test('Invitation accept returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('targetUserId', b.user.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('targetRowVersion', b.user.version); pm.environment.set('operatorAccessToken', b.accessToken); }

request.description: Purpose: read the authoritative current actor. Role: authenticated. Setup: login first. Expected: 200 Actor. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('GET me returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('actorVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: prove bearer is required. Role: none. Setup: none. Expected: 401. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('GET me without token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Purpose: update displayName with optimistic concurrency and idempotency. Role: authenticated self. Setup: run GET /me. Expected: 200 Actor. Data change: display name and one audit/idempotency record.

exec: pm.test('PATCH me returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('actorVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: reject stale optimistic concurrency. Role: authenticated self. Setup: login first. Expected: 412. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Stale PATCH me returns 412', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(412); });

request.description: Purpose: Supervisor reads an account and ETag. Role: Supervisor. Setup: set targetUserId and supervisorAccessToken. Expected: 200 Actor + ETag. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Account read returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('targetRowVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: prove non-Supervisor cannot read admin account projection. Role: non-Supervisor. Setup: operatorAccessToken and targetUserId. Expected: 403. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Wrong role account read returns 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

request.description: Purpose: change role/status with concurrency and revoke sessions. Role: Supervisor. Setup: run GET account; use disposable invited account. Expected: 200 Actor. Data change: role/status, session revocation, audit and idempotency receipt. Q17 rescue remains outside this request.

exec: pm.test('Account update returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Purpose: reset a disposable active account without echoing the secret. Role: Supervisor. Setup: target must be ACTIVE; set replacementPassword and supervisorAccessToken. Expected: 204. Data change: credential replacement, forced change, session revocation, audit/idempotency.

exec: pm.test('Password reset returns 204', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test('Password is not echoed', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.equal(''); });

request.description: Purpose: read the current user's profile. Role: authenticated user. Setup: run valid login first. Expected: 200 with profile and rowVersion. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Profile returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('profileRowVersion', pm.response.json().rowVersion);

request.description: Purpose: verify authorization enforcement. Role: none. Setup: no token. Expected: 401 ProblemDetails/stable error. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Unauthorized profile returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Purpose: update the current profile. Role: authenticated user. Setup: run GET /profile and use its rowVersion; use a fresh operationId. Expected: 200 or documented 409 conflict. Data change: updates profile.

exec: pm.test('Profile update returns 200 or 409', function () { pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Purpose: exercise administrative password reset. Role: Supervisor/admin policy. Setup: authenticate an allowed role and provide targetUserId/targetRowVersion from a permitted response. Expected: documented success or 400/403/404/409. Data change: destructive target credential change.

exec: pm.test('Reset returns a documented result', function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 403, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Password hash is not returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/passwordHash/i); });

request.description: Purpose: create a project smoke record. Role: project-management policy. Setup: authenticate an allowed role and set primaryProjectManagerUserId; run only with disposable data. Expected: 201 or documented validation/authorization/conflict error. Data change: creates project.

body.raw:
{
  "projectCode": "RG-POSTMAN-{{$timestamp}}",
  "name": "Postman smoke project",
  "description": "Created by Postman",
  "engineeringUtmSrid": 32648,
  "startDate": "2026-09-01",
  "endDate": "2027-09-01",
  "primaryProjectManagerUserId": "{{primaryProjectManagerUserId}}",
  "handover": { "documentNo": "HD-POSTMAN-{{$timestamp}}", "handoverDate": "2026-08-31", "fileId": null, "notes": "Postman smoke test" },
  "operationId": "{{$guid}}"
}

exec: pm.test('Project create returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 403, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('projectId', b.projectId); pm.collectionVariables.set('projectRowVersion', b.rowVersion); }

request.description: Purpose: read a project's work package. Role: authenticated user with project scope. Setup: set projectId from a permitted response. Expected: 200 or 401/403/404. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Work package returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Purpose: list notifications owned by the authenticated principal. Role: any seeded Development account. Setup: run valid login first. Expected: 200 NotificationPage; invalid cursor/limit returns 400. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Notification list returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('items'); if (b.items.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationId', b.items[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationVersion', b.items[0].version); } if (b.nextCursor) pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationCursor', b.nextCursor); }

request.description: Purpose: verify cursor validation. Role: authenticated user. Setup: run login first. Expected: 400 validation_error. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Invalid cursor returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description: Purpose: mark an owned notification as read. Role: authenticated owner. Setup: run GET /notifications and use notificationId/notificationVersion variables. Expected: 200 Notification with ETag. Run twice without changing notificationReadIdempotencyKey to verify replay; use a different version with the same key to verify conflict. Data change: marks one notification read.

exec: pm.test('Mark notification read returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 404, 409, 412]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: verify notification ownership/authentication boundary. Role: none. Setup: no token. Expected: 401. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Unauthorized notification list returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Purpose: read one notification owned by the authenticated principal. Setup: run notification list first. Expected: 200 with ETag or 404 when not owned. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Notification read returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: create a V2 survey plan. Role: Project Manager. Setup: login as PM and set projectId plus both route-version/segment fixtures when testing a multi-route scope. Expected: 201 with a SQL rowversion ETag, replay on same key, 409 on changed payload. Data change: creates normalized scope rows for every scope item.

exec: pm.test('Survey plan create returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 403, 404, 409, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyPlanId', b.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyPlanVersion', b.version); }

request.description: Purpose: postpone a plan with If-Match. Role: Project Manager. Setup: run create plan and use surveyPlanId/surveyPlanVersion. Expected: 200, 409 replay conflict, or 412 stale version.

exec: pm.test('Survey postpone returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 404, 409, 412, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyPlanVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: create and assign a V2 survey task. Role: Project Manager. Setup: set projectId, operatorId and valid multi-route scope fixtures. Expected: 201 with a rowversion ETag or documented validation/authorization/conflict.

exec: pm.test('Survey task create returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 403, 404, 409, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskId', b.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskVersion', b.version); }

request.description: Purpose: read a survey task. Role: PM, Supervisor or Operator. Setup: run create task first. Expected: 200 with ETag or 403/404.

exec: pm.test('Survey task read returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Purpose: list tasks assigned to the authenticated operator. Role: Operator. Setup: use operatorAccessToken; run create task as PM first when a live fixture is needed. Expected: 200 SurveyTaskPage, 400 for invalid cursor/limit, 403 for another role. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('My survey tasks list returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('items'); if (b.items.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskId', b.items[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskVersion', b.items[0].version); } if (b.nextCursor) pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskCursor', b.nextCursor); }

request.description: Purpose: accept an assigned survey task. Role: Operator who owns the active assignment. Setup: run list/read as operator and use surveyTaskVersion from the response. Expected: 200 with ETag, 412 for stale If-Match, 409 for idempotency conflict, 428 when preconditions are missing. Data change: assignment and task state transition.

exec: pm.test('Accept survey task returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 403, 404, 409, 412, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: decline an assigned survey task. Role: Operator who owns the active assignment. Setup: use a fresh unaccepted task and current version. Expected: 200 or documented 403/404/409/412/422. Data change: records rejection reason and ends assignment.

exec: pm.test('Decline survey task returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 403, 404, 409, 412, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: cancel an open survey task. Role: Project Manager with project scope. Setup: use a fresh task and current version. Expected: 200 or documented 403/404/409/412/422. Data change: marks the task cancelled with a reason.

exec: pm.test('Cancel survey task returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 403, 404, 409, 412, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: replace the active operator while preserving assignment history. Role: Project Manager with project scope. Setup: set operatorId2 to another active seeded operator and use current version. Expected: 200 or documented 403/404/409/412/422. Data change: ends the old assignment and creates a new one.

exec: pm.test('Reassign survey task returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([200, 403, 404, 409, 412, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskVersion', b.version); pm.collectionVariables.set('operatorId', b.operatorId); }

request.description: Purpose: request a supplementary survey scope. Role: Project Manager with project scope. Setup: task must have a related Survey row, use current version and valid published scope. Expected: 201 or documented 403/404/409/412/422. Data change: records a supplementary request and marks the task supplement-required.

exec: pm.test('Supplement request returns an expected result', function () { pm.expect([201, 403, 404, 409, 412, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if ([200, 201].includes(pm.response.code)) pm.collectionVariables.set('surveyTaskVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: verify that a non-operator cannot read the operator task list. Role: Project Manager or Supervisor. Setup: use accessToken from a non-operator login. Expected: 403 with access_forbidden. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Non-operator task list returns 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

request.description: Purpose: verify mutation preconditions are required. Role: Operator. Setup: authenticate as operator; omit Idempotency-Key and If-Match. Expected: 428 with no database effect. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Missing mutation preconditions return 428', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(428); });

request.description: Purpose: verify an operator cannot reassign a survey task. Role: Operator. Setup: use operatorAccessToken and a valid task id. Expected: 403 with no assignment change. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Operator reassign returns 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

request.description: Purpose: verify survey plan authentication boundary. Setup: no token. Expected: 401. Data change: none.

exec: pm.test('Unauthorized survey plan returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Purpose: verify required scope and enum validation. Setup: authenticate first. Expected: 400 or 422 with no persistence effect.

exec: pm.test('Invalid survey task returns validation status', function () { pm.expect([400, 403, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Purpose: verify If-Match and idempotency preconditions. Setup: authenticate first. Expected: 428 before persistence.

exec: pm.test('Missing precondition returns 428', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(428); });

request.description: Purpose: create a project-scoped multipart upload session. Role: Supervisor, PM, Operator or Crew with effective project membership. Setup: configure Development MinIO locally and set projectId/checksum for the actual 8 MiB test file. Expected: 201, ETag, id and fileId. Data change: file scope, immutable file record, session, audit and idempotency receipt.

exec: pm.test('Upload create returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

if (pm.response.code === 201) { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadId', b.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadFileId', b.fileId); pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadVersion', b.version); }

request.description: Purpose: issue a signed MinIO PUT URL for an issued part. Role: upload owner or authorized project actor. Setup: create the session first. Expected: 200 with one short-lived URL; use that URL outside the collection to PUT the exact part bytes and save its returned ETag. Signed URLs are intentionally not stored as variables or examples.

exec: pm.test('Part URL request returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Purpose: admit a completed multipart manifest for asynchronous verification. Setup: PUT every part to MinIO with each returned signed URL, then set uploadPartEtag and the current uploadVersion. Expected: 202 VERIFYING and a new ETag. Data change: persisted part ETags, verification outbox message and audit. It must not return VERIFIED from this request.

exec: pm.test('Upload complete returns 202', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });
if (pm.response.code === 202) pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: poll durable server upload state. Role: owner or authorized project actor. Expected: 200 and ETag. Poll after complete until VERIFIED or FAILED.

exec: pm.test('Upload session poll returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: Purpose: read scoped metadata after verification. Role: file owner or authorized project actor. Expected: 200 + ETag, 403 outside scope, 404 unknown file.

exec: pm.test('File metadata returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Purpose: stream a verified object through the authorization gateway. Role: file owner or authorized project actor. Expected: 200 binary only after VERIFIED; no signed GET URL is returned.

exec: pm.test('Verified file download returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Purpose: validation boundary. Setup: authenticated actor, omit If-Match. Expected: 428 before any database effect.

exec: pm.test('Missing If-Match returns 428', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(428); });

request.description: Purpose: authorization boundary. Setup: use a different actor without membership in the file project. Expected: 403 and no metadata leak.

exec: pm.test('Out-of-scope file metadata returns 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

request.description: P2-019. Assigned operator submits verified survey file IDs. Requires current survey task version. Captures datasetId and version on 201.

exec: pm.test('Dataset submit has an expected status', function () { pm.expect([201,403,404,409,412,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { var b=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('datasetId', b.id); }

request.description: P2-020. Coverage is UNKNOWN until position/quality evidence exists.

exec: pm.test('Dataset coverage returns 200 or a documented access result', function () { pm.expect([200,403,404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: P2-030. PM/Supervisor queues an immutable processing manifest. Captures job ID/version on 202.

exec: pm.test('Processing create has an expected status', function () { pm.expect([202,403,404,409,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 202) { var b=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('processingJobId', b.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('processingJobVersion', b.version); }

request.description: P2-031. Reads project-scoped processing job.

exec: pm.test('Processing read has an expected status', function () { pm.expect([200,403,404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set('processingJobVersion', pm.response.json().version);

request.description: P2-032. Only a retryable failure with current If-Match can retry.

exec: pm.test('Processing retry has an expected status', function () { pm.expect([200,403,404,409,412,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: P2-033. Internal callback only; token must carry client_type AI_SERVICE. Requires the exact active attempt and immutable manifest hash.

exec: pm.test('AI callback has an expected status', function () { pm.expect([200,401,403,404,409,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: P2-034. PM queues a validation run from immutable pair IDs.

exec: pm.test('Validation create has an expected status', function () { pm.expect([202,403,409,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 202) pm.collectionVariables.set('validationRunId', pm.response.json().id);

request.description: P2-034 negative case. Supervisor is not authorized to create a validation run.

exec: pm.test('Supervisor is forbidden', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

request.description: P2-035. PM/Supervisor reads durable validation result/provenance summary.

exec: pm.test('Validation read has an expected status', function () { pm.expect([200,403,404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
